Route Mark 7 is a beam face with three bearings on it and two of them struck out. 214/1,190 struck, initialled TA. 196/1,240 struck, initialled TA. 188/1,255 standing, in a harder pencil.

The hand that wrote all three never erases. A strike-through keeps the wrong number readable, which is how a route gets audited later, and it is also how you watch a route walk downhill: sixty-five metres of correction in two passes.

188 is followable. From this beam it runs to the Sector 44 crown, where hoist coverage stops at 1,880 metres.

Assessment: copy 188 and both struck figures together. The struck ones were correct when they were written, and the beam edge past the mark is cut without a rail.
external_site: Route marks in the HECTON-8 drowned factories are maintained in grease pencil over painted stock so a bearing can be corrected under pressure without removing the original figure. Standard practice strikes the superseded bearing and initials the strike.
field_note: Two corrections in one shift series is procedure working, not procedure failing. What it costs you is that the third figure is the only one anybody carried down.

audio: Camp is up, board is labelled, beds are signed. Descent card reads two one four, eleven ninety, and everybody copies it onto their own slate before they get wet. Kemp wanted the paperwork filed at the top and I told him no. We file when we lift. Nika is asking about the floor figure. Twenty-three point four. Twenty-three point four megapascals at the foundry floor.
in_game_wiki:
Four names, four jobs, one window. T. ANSARI route and lead, N. ORLU air and scrubbers, B. SEFF cutting and rigging, K. LOWRY claims and tender traffic. The lien is printed under the last line: JOINT WINDOW 6.2 T, JOINT AND SEVERAL.

Joint and several means any one of them clears all of it. The rotation printed beside the names is correct work. Nobody dives alone, the air tech signs the beds, the claims clerk does not cut.

The plate has six slots. Two are blanked with tape.

A recorder is still clipped under the frame, sealed and dry at 1.86 MPa. Assessment: this is the only surface where all four names appear together, and the recorder plays without drawing from the camp bus.
external_site: Marauder crews operating under Aegir Reclamation Pool tenders are commonly bound by a single joint tonne-window rather than individual liens. Recovered crew plates print the window figure alongside the roster, and the standard clause records the obligation as joint and several.
field_note: Survivorship does not divide the window. Read that line twice, because it means the last one breathing owed all six point two, and the six-two are why Barnard crews sign their own windows now.

Joint and several means any one of them clears all of it. The rotation printed beside the names is correct work. Nobody dives alone, the air tech signs the beds, the claims clerk does not cut.

The plate has six slots. Two are blanked with tape.

A recorder is still clipped under the frame, sealed and dry at 1.86 MPa. Assessment: this is the only surface where all four names appear together, and the recorder plays without drawing from the camp bus.
external_site: Marauder crews operating under Aegir Reclamation Pool tenders are commonly bound by a single joint tonne-window rather than individual liens. Recovered crew plates print the window figure alongside the roster, and the standard clause records the obligation as joint and several.
field_note: Survivorship does not divide the window. Read that line twice, because it means the last one breathing owed all six point two, and the six-two are why Barnard crews sign their own windows now.

title: Window Settlement Worksheet WS-11
scanner: Printed worksheet, pencil working in the margin, thermal edge scorched. Confidence 87 percent. Hazard: none. Limit: multiplier table continues on a sheet not present.
terminal: RECOVERY COMPLIANCE OFFICE / RETURN ACTION QUEUE / SCHEDULE WS-11 REV 2. ABORTED LIFT: CONSUMABLES DEBIT AT FULL ISSUE, NO CREDIT. DEPTH CLASS CREDIT: SEE TABLE. APPEAL: PACKET NOTARY INTERFACE. OFFICE: V. SATO-REN.
in_game_wiki:
WS-11 settles a tonne-window against what a crew actually lifts, and its arithmetic is why this camp is empty.

Printed: consumables spent on an aborted lift book as a debit at full issue, no credit. Recovered mass credits at the depth class it came from. Custody-grade off the foundry floor carries 2.8.

The margin does the rest in pencil. Window left to clear, 2.1. Abort and ascend, 0.9 debit, no credit, balance 3.0. Two cases at 0.55 from the floor, 1.10 lifted, credited 3.08, balance clear with 0.98 spare.

Going home cost them three tonnes of window. Going to 2,340 metres cost them nothing on paper.

The consumables line is filled for three: three transfer lines, three beds, 620 minutes each. Assessment: the multiplier still stands, and it still prices the floor below the surface.
external_site: Return Action Queue schedule WS-11 governs how a tonne-window lien is settled against recovered mass. An aborted lift books expended consumables as a debit at full issue value with no offsetting credit, while recovered mass is credited at a multiplier set by the depth class it was taken from.
field_note: Nobody ordered them down. The schedule only made the cheap direction the one that went down, and every figure in that margin is correct.

Printed: consumables spent on an aborted lift book as a debit at full issue, no credit. Recovered mass credits at the depth class it came from. Custody-grade off the foundry floor carries 2.8.

The margin does the rest in pencil. Window left to clear, 2.1. Abort and ascend, 0.9 debit, no credit, balance 3.0. Two cases at 0.55 from the floor, 1.10 lifted, credited 3.08, balance clear with 0.98 spare.

Going home cost them three tonnes of window. Going to 2,340 metres cost them nothing on paper.

The consumables line is filled for three: three transfer lines, three beds, 620 minutes each. Assessment: the multiplier still stands, and it still prices the floor below the surface.

title: Procedure AD-4, Attention Discipline
scanner: Laminated card, bolted to manifold frame, legible. Confidence 90 percent. Hazard: manifold charged. Limit: issue table referenced on the card is not present in this bay.
terminal:
ATLAS CONTINUITY OFFICE / PROCEDURE AD-4 REV 2
SCOPE: WET WORK ON TRANSFER LINE SUPPLY, 40 TO 140 M
INDICATORS: DELAYED RESPONSE TO INSTRUCTION, REPEATED QUERY, INAPPROPRIATE AFFECT
ESCALATION: 1 VERBAL. 2 WRITTEN. 3 REMOVAL FROM BAND, SUPPLEMENT FORFEIT.
BLEND AUTHORITY: MIX STATION, PER ISSUE TABLE.
CLASSIFICATION: CONDUCT. NOT A MEDICAL EVENT.
APPROVED: S. ARENDT
in_game_wiki:
Procedure AD-4 lists the signs of gas narcosis and routes them through a conduct ladder: delayed response to instruction, repeated queries, inappropriate affect. Verbal warning, written warning, removal from the band with the depth supplement forfeit. Conduct is a supervisor matter, and it generates no incident number and no exposure record.

AD-4 covers wet work to 140 metres, where the water reads 1.4 MPa. Blend authority sits with the mix station. The panel two metres from this card carries five regulators and three are set on Blend 2. Blend 1 is helium-bearing and metered; the helium bank valve behind it is shut under a decommission tag dated eleven months before AD-4 was revised.

Nineteen carbon copies hang on the clip behind the card. Seventeen are stage one. Assessment: Blend 2 fittings are serviceable and the manifold holds charge.
external_site: Deep Reach procedure documents recovered from HECTON-8 include AD-4, which lists the recognised indicators of gas narcosis and processes them through a three-stage conduct ladder. The procedure classifies the presentation as conduct rather than a medical event, which keeps it inside supervisor discretion and outside incident reporting.
field_note: Card says conduct, so the doctor never sees it and the file never shows it. Check the regulators before you trust anything printed in that bay - three of five still sit on the cheap blend.

Verbal warning, written warning, removal from the band with the depth supplement forfeit. Conduct is a supervisor matter, and it generates no incident number and no exposure record.

AD-4 covers wet work to 140 metres, where the water reads 1.4 MPa. Blend authority sits with the mix station. The panel two metres from this card carries five regulators and three are set on Blend 2. Blend 1 is helium-bearing and metered; the helium bank valve behind it is shut under a decommission tag dated eleven months before AD-4 was revised.

Nineteen carbon copies hang on the clip behind the card. Seventeen are stage one. Assessment: Blend 2 fittings are serviceable and the manifold holds charge.
external_site: Deep Reach procedure documents recovered from HECTON-8 include AD-4, which lists the recognised indicators of gas narcosis and processes them through a three-stage conduct ladder. The procedure classifies the presentation as conduct rather than a medical event, which keeps it inside supervisor discretion and outside incident reporting.
field_note: Card says conduct, so the doctor never sees it and the file never shows it. Check the regulators before you trust anything printed in that bay - three of five still sit on the cheap blend.

title: Receiver Handshake Schedule RH-4
scanner: Schedule plate over older board, two layers. Confidence 76 percent. Hazard: none. Limit: revision 3 overlays revision 1, lower layer only partly legible.
terminal:
RECOVERY COMPLIANCE OFFICE / SCHEDULE RH-4 REV 3
CARRIER: BLACK KEEL, AUTOMATED CLAIM-TENDER
WINDOW A, CARGO TENDER: 0140 / 0940 / 1740. TONNAGE CREDIT AT CLOSE.
WINDOW B, TRANSFER LINE: ON DEMAND, METERED.
WINDOW C, RECOVERY ASSIST: DISPLACES NEXT WINDOW A. CREDIT FORFEIT.
WINDOWS ARE NOT CUMULATIVE.
CLASSIFICATION: TENDER SCHEDULING, BILLABLE.
QUEUE: RETURN ACTION QUEUE.
in_game_wiki:
Window C is recovery assist. It displaces the next cargo tender and the tonnage credit is forfeit.

Schedule RH-4 sets the rest of the Black Keel's handshake windows: cargo tender at 0140, 0940 and 1740 with credit at close, transfer line on demand and metered. Receiver time is finite and the schedule attributes the cost of a displaced tender, which is defensible arithmetic. It also prices a call for help in the only currency a lien holder carries.

RH-4 is bolted over the 2147 tender board at P-63. The old board's Window C punch card is full at sixty-one, and the forfeit column beside it carries sixty-one.

Assessment: forfeit is per request, not per tonne. Windows do not stack.
external_site: Receiver handshake schedules issued by the Recovery Compliance Office time the Black Keel's automated claim-tender windows. Recovery assist is scheduled as a displacing window that consumes the next cargo tender and forfeits its tonnage credit, assessed per request rather than per tonne.
field_note: A C window takes the whole next cargo window with it and the credit never comes back, so if you are going to call one, call it once and clear the room while you are in there. Sixty-one punches on the old board.

ENTERED: 6.

in_game_wiki:
Pressure injury has no box on Intake MC-2. The form offers six categories and it enters as category six, other, non-specific.

Loss Desk Schedule 9 fixed the list so every Aegir site returned comparable figures. Category six is recorded and not aggregated, and site injury rate is one input to a tide-margin review.

Forty-one forms are spiked on the wall above Bed 4. Twenty-nine are category six.

The recompression chamber in the next bay carries an hour meter on the compressor housing. It reads 1,940 hours.

Bed 4's regulator manifold has been stripped back to the wall bracket. Assessment: the chamber is rated to 60 metres equivalent, 0.6 MPa, and its hatch is dogged from the inside.
external_site: Deep Reach clinical intake forms recovered from HECTON-8 use a fixed six-category injury list issued by the Keelmark Loss Desk. The list has no category for pressure injury, and such presentations were recorded as category six, other, non-specific, which is not aggregated into site injury rate.
field_note: There is no box for what the water does to you, so it goes in the box marked other, and other is not counted anywhere. The chamber next door logged nineteen hundred hours of something that officially never happened.

The slip was never torn from the cutter. The 2190 endorsement was printed onto it in place through the carrier link and reads DUTY DISCHARGED AT NOTARISATION.

Assessment: the interface still holds power and will print on demand. Its clock runs 43 years behind, so every slip it issues carries the wrong date.

field_note: It proves the message went out, and it was built to prove nothing past that. Compliance endorsed the slip in 2190 without ever putting a hand on it - print a copy, wrong clock and all, because it is the only dated record that the request existed.

Directive AS-19 sets what a lien holder may put on an open channel in Aegir Reclamation Pool water. No personal names against uncleared assets. No depth and bearing pairs for held lots. No accession codes in clear.

AS-19 is bolted to the mast at Shallow Annex P-63. Three metres above the plate a muster beacon has been repeating a 2147 recall in clear since the tide. The recall reads out eleven names.

Assessment: the beacon runs off the mast bus and will mask a hail on the same band. Isolate it at the bus before transmitting.
external_site: Asset Silence Board directives govern open-channel traffic by lien holders in Aegir Reclamation Pool water. Directive AS-19 prohibits personal names against uncleared assets, depth and bearing pairs for held lots, and accession codes in clear, and suspends the holder's tender window on breach.
field_note: Saying a dead worker's name on open channel costs you a tender window. The board that says so is bolted three metres under a beacon that has been saying eleven of them for forty-three years.

in_game_wiki:
The spanner at Filter Plant 3, 1,340 metres, has a ground box end, a handle bowed four degrees from being struck, and jaws spread from 24 millimetres to 25.4.

Clamp bolts sit forty millimetres off the housing wall; the tool for that gap is a crowfoot on an extension. Nine requisitions came back not in current catalogue: the stocking module had been stripped for material retention. Yusuf Brannick's fitting ticket stayed current. The plant's clamp torque procedure was never signed off, because signing it needed the tool.

So the clamps were turned with an open jaw, angled, from one side, for years. He struck his initials into the shank twice. The first set wore away.

Assessment: every clamp bolt in there is worn to one profile and will not take a rated socket. Bring his spanner or bring a cutter.
external_site: Hand tools recovered from HECTON-8 filter plants show wear patterns consistent with sustained use outside their rated application. A 24 millimetre combination spanner recovered at Filter Plant 3 has jaws spread to 25.4 millimetres, a ground box end and a bowed handle, with clamp fasteners across the plant deformed to a matching profile.
field_note: Nine requisitions and then operator discretion, which is the paperwork for making it your problem - and his jaws sit at 25.4 with every clamp in there worn to match. That ground spanner is the only thing left on this site that turns Filter Plant 3.

scanner: Three handwritten notes pinned under an instrument plate. Confidence 87 percent. Hazard: plate fasteners seized. Limit: paper is captive under 27 kilograms.
terminal:
AEGIR OPERATIONS RISK / TRANSIT CLEARANCE 44-W-0416, 2147
RUN: CROWN TO SECTION 1 VALVE HOUSE. TIDE MARGIN: DOWNGRADED, ACCEPTED.
PERSONNEL: ZHALEH, C. - RELIEF PRESSURE ATTENDANT
ASSIGNED BOARD: SECTION 11.
SECTION 11 BOARD: MANNED, CONTINUOUS.
OPERATIONS RISK: I. VARNEK
audio: Section 11 board, hour thirty-six, Adeyemi on watch. Crown, confirm relief on the walk-round. Say that again. Relief logged out at 04:00 for Section 1. Section 1 has no board, Crown, it has a valve house. I am Section 11. Read my section back to me. You read Section 1 again.
in_game_wiki:
Three handover notes are pinned to the Section 11 pressure board at 2,012 metres, one hand throughout, all addressed to Corin Zhaleh. Items numbered one to six on the first, one to nine on the third. Each ends in an empty box drawn for the incoming initials.

A watch board is not left unmanned. Sigrun Adeyemi held a twelve-hour ticket and signed the board log at twelve, twenty-four and thirty-six hours, which is three tickets' worth of watch on one certification. Zhaleh was cleared out of Crown against a transit window with the tide margin downgraded, on a run booked to the Section 1 valve house.

Assessment: the notes are captive under the transducer plate. The plate is 27 kilograms of rated instrument, and lifting it drops the paper into the water.
external_site: Watchkeeping records recovered from HECTON-8 Section 11 include three successive handover notes written by the same attendant to the same named relief, with the incoming signature blocks left blank. Board log signatures place the attendant on continuous watch across thirty-six hours against a twelve-hour certification.
field_note: The clearance sent her relief to a valve house, and the same file reads Section 11 board manned continuous - which it was, by one person, for thirty-six hours. If you want that plate, take the paper off it first and dry-can it.

terminal:
AEGIR CONTINUITY HOLDINGS / PERSONNEL 44-C-0117
ILVES, T. - PRESSURE DOOR FITTER, GRADE 2, CROWN MUSTER TO FOUNDRY GALLERY 4.
BAND ELECTION: B. ATTENDANCE: 100 PERCENT. DISCIPLINARY: NONE.
SEAL CERTIFICATION: CURRENT UNDER EXTENSION 44-E-19.
STATUS: ASSET REASSIGNMENT, PENDING DETERMINATION.
in_game_wiki:
Teodora Ilves fitted pressure doors on the crown run, 1,904 metres down to Foundry Gallery 4. Her file records Band B and perfect attendance.

The locker argues with the file. Three scrubber cartridges inside are stamped to other names. The gloves are two sizes off her issue. Taped to the inner door skin is her own copy of the roster, with a grease-pencil swap chart running eleven weeks: who took whose deep shift, and which lapsed seal certification the swap was keeping off the roster. Extension 44-E-19 is hers.

The chart is drawn on the door skin, and the door is 31 kilograms of rated alloy.

Assessment: the door shims stacked in the base are salvage and the chart is not. Cutting the panel free takes the pencil with it.
external_site: Personal lockers recovered from HECTON-8 crown muster rows frequently contradict the shift rosters filed for the same workers. Locker 44-C-17 held consumable cartridges stamped to three other names, mismatched issue gear, and a hand-annotated roster copy recording eleven weeks of undeclared shift swaps.
field_note: Her file says Band B and the pencil says she was running Band C work on a swapped certificate so neither of them got pulled off the roster. Read that door before you cut it, because you only get one of the two things in this locker.

in_game_wiki:
Proof weight PW-9 is 240 kilograms of cast lead in a steel shell, issued to hoist rigger Emeka Lindqvist for daily proof loads at the crown, where the hoists stop.

All four edges carry his hoist-stop readings, struck with a 3 millimetre drift and hit twice each so they read through silt. Eleven years of them, one per shift start. The run goes 1,880, 1,880, 1,880, and by the last edge it reads 1,884. The drawings kept the crown datum at 1,880 throughout. Striking a rated weight voids its proof certification, which is why the readings sit on the lead instead of in the log, and Deep Reach carried the same movement as calibration drift.

Assessment: 240 kilograms against a 4,800 kilogram window. The claim-tender books lead by mass and reads nothing on the edges.
external_site: A rated proof weight recovered from the HECTON-8 crown hoist deck carries eleven years of crown datum readings struck into its edges by its assigned rigger, one per shift start, running from 1,880 metres to 1,884 metres.
field_note: Recover as scrap, not as record - that disposition line does the whole job, because a melt has no edges. Eleven years of crown readings costs you five percent of the window, and the tender will pay you for the lead either way.

terminal:
ATLAS CONTINUITY OFFICE / SEAL CARD G-77
REPAIR: TAPE, 11 TURNS, HALF LAP.
SIGNATORY: PETRIC, L. - SUMP GREASER, GRADE 1, SUMP HEAD 1 TO GALLERY 6.
DETERMINATION: NOT VALID FOR A CLASS 2 SEAL. REPAIR NOT ACCEPTED.
REPLACEMENT: WEEK 41. GALLERY 6 TRUNK: DRY.
in_game_wiki:
Gland collar G-77 carries a hairline fracture ninety millimetres long and eleven turns of pressure tape, half-lapped, with the turn count written on the outer lap in marker. LUBO PETRIC, 14-9.

Half lap over a collar shoulder is the correct wrap. The collar carries the load, the tape carries the seal, and a count written on the outside lets the next hand check tension without cutting it open. He did all of that. He was a Grade 1 greaser with no pressure certification, the seal card wanted a Class 2 signature, so he signed the Class 2 line and the office refused the repair.

Week 41 did not come.

Assessment: the trunk behind G-77 is dry at 1,940 metres, 19.4 MPa, forty-three years on. Dry, not breathable. It will take a person and a tool bag clear of the water.
external_site: A tape seal recovered intact from HECTON-8 gland collar G-77 remains pressure-tight after forty-three years of submersion, retaining a dry cable trunk at 1,940 metres. The wrap is eleven turns, half-lapped over the collar shoulder, with the turn count and the fitter's name written on the outer lap.
field_note: Eleven turns, half lap, count on the outside - that is the wrap straight out of the manual, signed by a greaser who was not allowed to sign it. Work in that trunk and keep your bottle sealed; the tape only bought you dry, and dry is a lot.

in_game_wiki:
Medical Post 2 sorted casualties into four printed categories: ambulatory, assisted, stretcher, deferred. Deferred was a movement category. Once the quarantine gate held extraction, nothing could be moved, and every row on the form resolves to four.

So the page is column four, forty times. Petra Nkemdirim ruled a fifth column with the edge of her ID card - every added rule line on that page is fifty-four millimetres - and tallied the injuries the form had no row for. She continued on the reverse, then on a dressing wrapper.

Her triage authority was provisional. Sort, do not sign. She signed the bottom of a column she had drawn herself.

Assessment: the cabinet under the board holds four sealed scrubber cartridges, and the hinge will take one pass.

field_note: Four was the gate, not the wound - the form was doing custody and she was doing medicine on the back of it. Cartridges or the wrapper, one trip: the cartridges are air and the wrapper is the only casualty count anyone ever made.

Her triage authority was provisional. Sort, do not sign. She signed the bottom of a column she had drawn herself.

Assessment: the cabinet under the board holds four sealed scrubber cartridges, and the hinge will take one pass.
